summary.intent: Build a skill improvement engine for the `entire` CLI that mines agent transcripts to surface usage metrics and LLM-generated improvement suggestions for repo-specific skill files (e.g., `.claude/skills/e2e/SKILL.md`).
summary.outcome: Fully implemented and committed the skill improvement engine: a new `entire skill` Cobra command with a Bubbletea TUI, a dedicated SQLite analytics DB (`skilldb`), LLM-powered suggestion generation (`skillimprove`), multi-agent skill discovery, and insightsdb query extensions. All unit, integration, and E2E canary tests pass.

repo: The `insightsdb` already tracks `skill_signals` per session (skill name, path, friction, missing instructions) — a ready-made data source for skill analytics.
The `improve/generator.go` pattern using `attachTranscriptExcerpts` and `llmcli` is the established way to feed transcript evidence into LLM prompts.
Gemini uses `.gemini/agents/` and `.gemini/commands/` (markdown with YAML headers), not a `skills/` directory — there is no `.codex/` skill system.
The lint task runs `golangci-lint --fix` which can mutate unrelated files (e.g., stripped nolint comments from `memorylooptui/root.go`), requiring selective staging at commit time.
The `tool_calls` map in sessions counts `Skill` invocations but does not distinguish individual skill names — a gap filled by the new `skilldb` cache.
New SQLite DBs follow the `insightsdb` pattern: a `cache_meta` table tracks the last-seen checkpoint branch tip to enable stale-check refreshes.

code.finding: Added `QuerySkillSignalsForSkills` and `QuerySkillToolCallSessions` — new query methods needed to populate skilldb from insightsdb.
Schema uses composite primary key `(name, source_agent)` on the `skills` table; all related tables (`skill_sessions`, `skill_improvements`, etc.) must also carry `source_agent` for correct joins.
A `//nolint` comment placed on a wrapper line was stripped by `golangci-lint --fix`; the nolint directive must be on the specific offending line (the `fmt.Sprintf` call itself).

workflow: Design was validated section-by-section via `AskUserQuestion` before writing the spec, avoiding late-stage rework.
Spec self-review caught a schema consistency bug (missing `source_agent` in child tables) before implementation began.
Launching parallel agents for independent packages (db.go+queries.go, discovery.go, skillimprove/) significantly reduced implementation time.
Running `golangci-lint --fix` can silently modify files outside the intended scope; always check `git diff` before staging to avoid bundling unrelated linter cleanups into feature commits.
The Vogon canary E2E tests serve as the final integration gate after unit and integration tests pass.

friction: The linter (`golangci-lint --fix`) modified `memorylooptui/root.go` (an unrelated file) by stripping nolint comments, requiring a `git checkout` restore and careful selective staging.
The linter also replaced `fmt.Errorf` with `errors.New` in `skill_cmd.go` but did not add the `errors` import, causing a build failure that required a manual fix.
A `//nolint` comment was stripped by the linter on the next `--fix` pass, requiring re-placement on the exact offending line rather than a wrapper line.
The `insightsdb` `tool_calls` map doesn't distinguish individual skill names, meaning invocation counts required a separate transcript grep pass rather than a simple DB query.
open_items: Cross-repo skill analytics aggregation (Approach C consideration) was deferred — the current DB is per-repo only.
Transcript grep for friction-free skill sessions is implemented as a cache population step but its performance at scale (large checkpoint branches) has not been benchmarked.
Gemini `.gemini/agents/` and `.gemini/commands/` skill discovery is included in the schema and discovery code but has not been tested against a real Gemini-instrumented repo.
The `outcome` column in `skill_sessions` (values: `success`, `partial`, `friction`) is defined in the schema but the classification logic in `cache.go` may need tuning based on real data.
The spec document was written to `docs/superpowers/specs/` but was excluded from the commit (noted as gitignored) — its persistence in the repo should be verified.
